pharmacySolutions.title: Pharmacy Solutions
pharmacySolutions.description: A secure, user-friendly e-commerce platform for buying medicines and medical supplies online.
pharmacySolutions.challenge: Pharmacies in Kuwait needed a way to sell medicines and medical supplies online without sacrificing the trust and accuracy a pharmacy requires.
pharmacySolutions.approach: We built a secure e-commerce platform with verified product listings, prescription-aware checkout, and an admin panel built around how a pharmacy actually manages stock.
pharmacySolutions.result: A live platform pharmacy staff can run day-to-day, with a shopping experience customers trust.

fekrativity.title: Fekrativity
fekrativity.description: An events management agency site covering everything from concept design to execution, with VR/AR experiences.
fekrativity.challenge: An events management agency needed a site that could showcase end-to-end event production — from concept to execution — including immersive VR/AR experiences.
fekrativity.approach: We designed a portfolio-driven site structured around their service categories, built to present past events and immersive experiences clearly to prospective clients.
fekrativity.result: A professional online presence that reflects the creativity of their event production work.

wildOasis.title: Wild Oasis
wildOasis.description: A luxury cabin booking platform with immersive mountain-forest visuals and reservation management.
wildOasis.challenge: A cabin rental business needed a booking platform that matched the immersive, high-end feel of staying in a mountain-forest cabin.
wildOasis.approach: We built a reservation system with real-time availability and rich visuals, so the booking experience feels as premium as the stay itself.
wildOasis.result: A booking platform guests can browse and reserve confidently, end to end.

beautyCenter.title: Beauty Center
beautyCenter.description: A Saudi B2B marketplace uniting local and global beauty brands across 800,000+ products.
beautyCenter.challenge: A Saudi B2B marketplace needed to unite local and global beauty brands across hundreds of thousands of products in one usable platform.
beautyCenter.approach: We built a B2B e-commerce experience designed for bulk browsing and ordering at scale, organizing a massive catalog without overwhelming buyers.
beautyCenter.result: A marketplace that makes an 800,000+ product catalog genuinely navigable for business buyers.

ezyRent.title: EzyRent
ezyRent.description: A global rental marketplace with real-time availability across thousands of verified listings.
ezyRent.challenge: A rental marketplace needed real-time availability across thousands of listings without the search experience breaking down at scale.
ezyRent.approach: We built a fast, filterable browsing experience backed by a marketplace architecture that keeps availability accurate as listings grow.
ezyRent.result: A rental platform that stays fast and reliable as its listing count scales.

keyper.title: Keyper
keyper.description: A premium landing page for a real estate advisory firm, guiding clients from discovery to closing.
keyper.challenge: A real estate advisory firm needed a landing page that could guide prospective clients from first visit to a booked consultation.
keyper.approach: We designed a focused, premium landing page structured around the firm's advisory process, from discovery to closing.
keyper.result: A clear, professional entry point that turns visits into consultations.

discoverEgypt.title: Discover Egypt
discoverEgypt.description: A travel companion platform blending historical exploration with modern, verified local insights.
discoverEgypt.challenge: Travelers exploring Egypt needed a single, modern platform blending historical context with verified, practical local insights.
discoverEgypt.approach: We built a travel companion experience that pairs historical exploration content with up-to-date, locally verified information.
discoverEgypt.result: A modern guide that makes discovering Egypt easier and more reliable for visitors.

faq.q1: Is School 360 built on a platform we can trust long-term?
faq.a1: Yes — it's built on Odoo 19, a mature open-source ERP used worldwide, so you're never locked into a closed system.
faq.q2: Can it be customized for how our school actually works?
faq.a2: Yes — as an Odoo-based system, modules can be configured or extended to match your school's specific workflow.
faq.q3: Does it really work fully in Arabic?
faq.a3: Completely. The portal, notifications, and reports are fully localized for Arabic-speaking staff, parents and students.

termsPage.intro: These Terms of Service govern your relationship with Nojeed Software Solutions ("Nojeed", "we", "us", or "our"), a software development agency based in Giza, Egypt. Please read them carefully.

The specific scope, deliverables, timeline, and pricing for each engagement are defined in a separate Statement of Work or project proposal agreed upon in writing by both parties.

Delays caused by the client may affect the delivery schedule and may incur additional costs.

s9.body: Either party may terminate an engagement by providing written notice to the other party. Upon termination, the client is responsible for payment of all work completed and expenses incurred up to the termination date. Nojeed will deliver all completed work product paid for by the client.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Nojeed Software Solutions ("Nojeed", "we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects information when you visit our website or engage with our services.

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.body: We collect information you voluntarily provide when contacting us through our website — specifically your name, email address, project type, and message content. We do not collect payment details directly; any transactions are handled through secure third-party platforms. We also collect anonymized usage data through analytics tools (see Section 4).

s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
s2.body: We use the information you provide to: respond to your inquiry and prepare proposals; communicate project progress and updates; improve our services and client experience; and comply with applicable legal obligations. We do not use your personal information for unsolicited marketing.

s3.title: 3. Legal Basis for Processing
s3.body: We process your personal data on the basis of your consent (when you submit our contact form), the performance of a contract (when we engage to deliver services), and our legitimate interests in operating and improving our business.

s4.title: 4. Analytics
s4.body: Our website uses Google Analytics and Vercel Analytics to understand how visitors interact with our pages. These tools collect anonymized data such as page views, session duration, and referral sources. No personally identifiable information is shared with these services. You can opt out of Google Analytics by installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on available at tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout.

s5.title: 5. Cookies
s5.body: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to improve website functionality and analyze usage patterns. You can control cookie settings through your browser. Disabling cookies may affect the functionality of some parts of our website. We do not use cookies for advertising purposes.

s6.title: 6. Sharing of Information
s6.body: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We may share your information with trusted third-party service providers (such as hosting and email providers) strictly to the extent necessary to operate our services. We may also disclose information when required by law or to protect the rights and safety of Nojeed and others.

s7.title: 7. Data Security
s7.body: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure. While we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

s8.title: 8. Data Retention
s8.body: We retain contact form submissions and project-related communications for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, or as required by applicable law. You may request deletion of your data at any time (see Section 9).

s9.title: 9. Your Rights
s9.body: You have the right to access the personal data we hold about you, request corrections to inaccurate data, request deletion of your data, and withdraw consent for processing at any time. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at nojeed.eg@gmail.com. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe.

s10.title: 10. Third-Party Links
s10.body: Our website may contain links to third-party websites (such as our social media profiles or client sites). We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites and encourage you to review their privacy policies independently.

s11.title: 11. Children's Privacy
s11.body: Our services are not directed to individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If you believe we have inadvertently collected such information, please contact us and we will promptly delete it.

s12.title: 12. Changes to This Policy
s12.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated date. Your continued use of our website or services after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy.

s13.title: 13. Contact
s13.body: For any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us at nojeed.eg@gmail.com or by phone at +20 128 662 3451.
